entry_points.summary: Conversational idea-sharpening on-ramp — probes, reframes, and converges a vague idea into a buildable problem statement. Bounded (never full /z-grill exhaustiveness). Writes GRILL.md as precontext for /z-plan or /z-brainstorm; also auto-invoked as /z-brainstorm Phase 0.

Stage 1 (framing restate) → Stage 2 (probe/clarify/reframe with bounded adaptive escalation) → Stage 3 (convergence gate) → Stage 4 (GRILL.md artifact + route handoff). Stop once buildable — do NOT exhaustively interrogate every dimension.

Writes $Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR/GRILL.md using the exact schema /z-grill produces: frontmatter generated_at/status:complete/slug; body sections Sharpened problem, Pain evidence, Who else has this, Dumbest version, Killed scope, Open branches, Recommended next command.

invariants: The user always owns convergence — AI never writes GRILL.md before user signals convergence
Bounded adaptive escalation: start conversational; escalate to pin a fuzzy dimension only as needed; stop once the idea is buildable
Never exhaustively interrogate every dimension — that is /z-grill's job
Abandon is clean — no GRILL.md artifact written on abandon
No subagents for the interview itself — Explore (Haiku) is the only subagent, used to self-serve codebase-answerable questions
Writes GRILL.md (NOT BRAINSTORM.md) — schema identical to /z-grill output
Three logging events: sharpen_run_start, sharpen_convergence, sharpen_run_end
Slug collision on existing precontext-only GRILL.md = continuation/overwrite; finished-plan = ask
Empty $ARGUMENTS opens with 'What are you thinking about?'
Never auto-dispatches to /z-plan or /z-brainstorm — advisory handoff only
gotchas: z-sharpen = adaptive + bounded; /z-grill = exhaustive + deliberate — keep the two distinguishable so z-grill is not vestigial
Writes GRILL.md not BRAINSTORM.md — downstream commands that expect BRAINSTORM.md will not find z-sharpen output there
planning-router rule 5: premise_underspecified routes to /z-sharpen only if current_command is NOT /z-sharpen (loop prevention)
GRILL.md schema is shared with /z-grill — last-writer-wins if both run on one slug
No active-plan registration — /z-sharpen is not a plan-family command
